title: 💰 Version 1.3.0 • Cheaper Upgrades!
message: Great news, Conductor! We've slashed the prices across the entire game so you can grow your rail empire faster and easier than ever before.
points: 💵 Lower Prices Everywhere: Engines, coaches, freight cars, and parcel vans now cost much less to buy.
🏗️ Cheaper Station Upgrades: Buildings, tracks, and platform styles are now easier to afford.
🚉 Affordable Platform Expansion: Unlocking new platforms costs a lot less now.
🔧 Cheaper Train Building: Assembling and editing trains now costs less cash.
🚀 Grow your empire faster and spend more time running trains, not saving up!

title: 💎 Version 1.2.0 • VIP Rail Store & Flash Deals!
message: An exciting update introducing our brand new VIP Rail Store, secret scratch deals, instant ad-skipping, and extra smooth gameplay!
points: 💎 VIP Rail Store: Unlock Lifetime VIP Access to enjoy a completely ad-free experience with maximum rewards!
🎟️ Secret Scratch Deals: Scratch for special limited-time discounts on permanent VIP passes.
⚡ Instant Ad-Free Rewards: VIP members automatically skip all video ads and claim rewards instantly.
🚀 Smoother Gameplay: Improved app performance and train animations for a seamless 60 FPS experience.

title: 🎉 Version 1.1.0 • Daily Rewards & DevDuo Hub!
message: A major update featuring our brand new Daily Reward Hub, DevDuo Apps Showcase, and smoother gameplay!
points: 🎁 Daily Reward Hub: Dispatch VIP Express trains daily for mystery cash payouts up to $1.0M!
📱 DevDuo Software Hub: Discover all apps and games created by DevDuo Software directly inside settings.
🔔 Live Update Checker: Instantly check for new features, release notes, and version updates.
⚡ Performance Boost: Engine optimizations for extra smooth 60 FPS train animations.
